## TopAI Clean Web-to-Markdown RAG Scraper (Sub-30ms, Zero LLM Token Burn)

### How it works

This workflow runs manually and sends a single HTTP POST request to the TopAI Web-to-Markdown API. It is designed to convert web content into clean Markdown for downstream RAG or scraping use cases without using LLM tokens inside n8n.

### Setup steps

- Configure the HTTP Request node with a valid TopAI API key from topaigateway.com.
- Set or verify the target URL and request body parameters required by the TopAI Web-to-Markdown endpoint.
- Run the Manual Trigger to test the API call and inspect the Markdown response.

### Customization

Adjust the HTTP request payload to change the source URL, output formatting options, or any TopAI-specific scraping parameters.

## Manual API scrape

A compact two-node flow where the manual trigger starts the workflow and the adjacent HTTP Request node calls the TopAI Web-to-Markdown API to retrieve cleaned Markdown content.
